paper_title: MedEthicsQA A Comprehensive Question Answering Benchmark for Medical   Ethics Evaluation of LLMs
caption: Illustration of taxonomy on medical ethics. The inner circle encapsulates four pillar principles in medicine, and the outer circle represents the 26 categories clustered from 256 detailed principles.
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the taxonomy of medical ethics, comprising a central circle divided into four sections and an outer circle with 26 categories. The central circle is segmented into four distinct sections: Beneficence, Non-Maleficence, Autonomy, and Justice, each represented by a different color. The Beneficence section, colored blue, is further divided into eight subcategories, including Provide Assistance in Emergency, Respect Life, Dignity of Patients, and Continual Learning, among others. The Non-Maleficence section, colored purple, consists of four subcategories. The Autonomy section, colored green, comprises seven subcategories. The Justice section, colored orange, includes four subcategories. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels, or visually emphasized slices. The subcategories appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, starting from the top of each section.
